name: Ampelmann merchandise
about: The Ampelmann is the little traffic-light man from East Berlin, and he has become a popular symbol of the city. His shop sells many small gifts based on him.
tip: Check that the item has an official trademark before you buy.

name: KPM porcelain
about: KPM is the Berlin Royal Porcelain Manufactury, a famous porcelain maker with a long history in the city.
tip: Plates may be sold separately, so check what is included in the price.
